name: qlrisk_xva
title: XVA and CVA capital
description: Valuation adjustments and CVA capital. measure cva (unilateral or bilateral, analytic or Monte Carlo, optional wrong-way), dva, fva, kva, mva run qlrisk's calculators on an exposure profile; 'total' runs any of them together (inputs: {cva: {...}, dva: {...}, ..., colva: number}) and sums them; 'sa_cva' is the MAR50 standardised CVA capital from an expected-exposure profile and the counterparty's credit curve, with optional hedge trades; 'ba_cva' is the basic approach (reduced, or full with hedges). Fields: cva: ee_profile (array, required); time_grid (array, required); credit_spread (number, required); recovery_rate (number, default 0.4); spread_term_structure (array); discount_rates (array); risk_free_rate (number, default 0.05); own_credit_spread (['number', 'null']); own_recovery_rate (number, default 0.4); notional (number, default 1.0). dva: exposure_profile (array); time_grid (array); own_pd_curve (object); own_lgd (number, default 0.6); discount_curve (object). fva: exposure_profile (array); time_grid (array); funding_spread (number, default 0.01); discount_curve (object); counterparty_survival_curve (object). kva: ead_profile (array); time_grid (array); counterparty_pd (number, default 0.01); counterparty_lgd (number, default 0.45); cost_of_capital (number, default 0.1); discount_curve (object); capital_floor (number, default 0.0003). mva: initial_margin_profile (array); time_grid (array); funding_spread (number, default 0.01); discount_curve (object). Config: cva: method (analytical|monte_carlo|sa_cva), bilateral, wrong_way_risk, wwr_correlation. Inputs: measure, inputs, counterparty, time_grid, expected_exposure, recovery_pct; the rest (config, market_data, reporting_currency, counterparty_buckets, hedges, m_cva, reference_buckets, counterparties, index_hedges) in the optional `advanced` object. Inputs: measure, inputs, counterparty, time_grid, expected_exposure, recovery_pct; the rest (config, market_data, reporting_currency, counterparty_buckets, hedges, m_cva, reference_buckets, counterparties, index_hedges) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"measure": "cva", "inputs": {"ee_profile": [400000, 600000, 700000, 650000, 500000], "time_grid": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], "credit_spread": 0.01, "recovery_rate": 0.4}} gives CVA: 19,637.64 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
